label: YouTube channel
description: Subscribers, lifetime views and video count for your channel, pulled from the YouTube Data API. Free; needs an API key.

metrics.name: YouTube subscribers
metrics.definition: Channel subscribers. Cumulative: read the change over time, not the total.

metrics.name: YouTube views
metrics.definition: Lifetime channel views. Cumulative: a threshold on the total is meaningless, watch the weekly change.

jobs.label: YouTube insights
jobs.note: Claude reads the history and writes what it says (and what it can't).
jobs.prompt: Read the history of the YouTube metrics with `python3 brain.py metric show youtube_subscribers` and the same for youtube_views. Write a short, honest read of the trend: growth per week, any change in pace, and what you cannot conclude from so few data points. File it with `python3 brain.py doc add "YouTube trend read" --kind note --dept marketing --tags youtube --body "..."` (or `doc update youtube-trend-read` if it exists), then log it with `python3 brain.py log add --type report --title "YouTube trend read"`. Never invent a number.
